data.name: Wizard Monkey
targeting_extra: Wall of Fire: Close default; with Guided Magic obeys target priority
data.damage_type: Energy (cannot pop Purple/Lead until Arcane Spike or Fireball/Necro)
data.crosspath_rule: Standard BTD6: one path to tier 5, a second path up to tier 2, third path locked at 0.

1.name: Guided Magic
1.text: Bolts seek Bloons over short distance, ignore line-of-sight blockers. Crosspath: Fireball/Dragon's Breath ignore blockers and last 2x; Wall of Fire +2s duration, gets placement targeting and can be placed behind blockers; phoenix flames gain homing; Shimmer triggers behind blockers; Necro undead last significantly longer.

1.name: Arcane Blast
1.text: Damage 1->2, projectile size +50%. Crosspath Fireball: explosion damage +1.

1.name: Arcane Mastery
1.text: Range +50%, attack speed x2, pierce +4 (total 7), damage +1 (total 3), lifespan +75%. With Fireball: fireball lifespan +75%, explosion pierce 15->19.

1.name: Arcane Spike
1.text: Attack speed x2, damage 3->6, +10 MOAB-class damage (+11 with Arcane Impale MK; +1 Ceramic with MK). Can pop Lead. Crosspath 2xx: Fireball +6 MOAB damage, Wall of Fire +2 MOAB damage, fireball pierce 19.

1.name: Archmage
1.text: Main bolt dmg 6->8, MOAB bonus 10->19 (20 w/ Impale), pierce 7->11 (16 with 5-0-1), cooldown 0.1375s. Gains Dragon's Breath (cooldown 0.0675s vs 0.135, +8 MOAB dmg per flame) and Shimmer (every 1s instead of 2s). Crosspath Fireball: 3 fireballs, dmg 2->9, +24 MOAB, pierce 19->23, cooldown 1.1s. Crosspath Wall of Fire: MOAB +2->+6, deploys twice as fast, cooldown 3.25s.

2.name: Fireball
2.text: Secondary attack: exploding fireball. Fireball hits 1 bloon for 1 fire dmg, explosion 1 dmg to up to 15 bloons. Fire type: does not explode on Purple.

2.name: Wall of Fire
2.text: Deploys wall of fire on closest track part; 1 dmg every 0.15s up to 10 bloons (pierce refreshes); every 6.5s, lasts 4.5s or until touching Purple.

2.name: Dragon's Breath
2.text: New flame attack (2 fire dmg, pierce 3, cd 0.135s) with burn DoT 1/1.5s for 3.1s. Fireball now 3 per shot in 60 degree spread, explosion dmg 3 and larger radius. Wall of Fire cd 6.5->4.5s, pierce 20, tick 0.1s. Flame Jet MK: +50% flame speed.

2.name: Summon Phoenix
2.text: Ability: summon phoenix sub-tower for 20s, circles screen center, infinite range, ignores blockers, 5 fire dmg, pierce 8, cd 0.1s (cannot pop Purple). Ability cd 45s, initial 15s. Dragon's Breath now fires 2 flames/shot at 10 degree spread.

2.name: Wizard Lord Phoenix
2.text: Ability turns Wizard into Lava Phoenix for 20s (stops other attacks): flames 20 dmg pierce 50 cd 0.1s plus 8 meteors/s (50 dmg, pierce 300; meteors hit all bloon types incl. Purple). Permanent phoenix sub-tower (same as tier 4). Fireball explosion 3->9, Wall dmg 1->5, DB: 3 flames/15 degrees, pierce 15, DoT 30 over 15s.

3.name: Intense Magic
3.text: Pierce +5, projectile speed x2 (doubles travel distance). Crosspath: Fireball explosion pierce +5, Wall of Fire tick pierce +5, Dragon's Breath pierce +2 and speed/distance x2 (also Archmage DB).

3.name: Monkey Sense
3.text: Range +10 (25% of base), detects Camo. With Archmage: Shimmer projectile radius +~16.7%.

3.name: Shimmer
3.text: Aura attack that permanently removes Camo from bloons (incl. DDTs), no damage, pierce 500, cd 2s, radius 125% of base range (75). Range +10 (50->60).

3.name: Necromancer: Unpopped Army
3.text: Graveyard counter of nearby pops; spends units to summon Undead Bloons (groups of 1-4, 2 normal dmg, variable pierce) that travel backwards along track. Full graveyard speeds undead attack and boosts all Wizard damage. New targeting option sets undead deploy location.

3.name: Prince of Darkness
3.text: Summons Undead MOABs and BFBs; attacks 4x faster (1.1->0.275s), Shimmer 2x faster, acquisition range 60->80. Buffs all Necromancer Wizards: undead damage +3. Graveyard 500->3000; bonus dmg per unit 200->300 up to +10; Super Ceramic bonus 7-13 -> 7-10.

paragon.name: Magus Perfectus
paragon.requirement: One Archmage, Wizard Lord Phoenix and Prince of Darkness on map simultaneously; absorbs all other Wizards. Degree 1-100 by pops, cash generated, extra cash invested.
paragon.effect: Mana mechanic (cap 99,999, starts full; >=50,000 mana halves main attack cooldowns). Main attack: homing upgraded Arcane Spike (50 mana/shot, pops spawn Undead Bloons at 250 mana each). Dark Phoenix circles tower, fire breath (50 mana, targets First) + radial burst of 8 fireballs (free). Draining Beam toggle: range 120, restores 250 mana/attack, 100 dmg degree 1, disables other attacks. Ability Phoenix Explosion: consumes all mana, DoT within 100 units every 0.5s for 30s, one Undead ZOMG per 9,000 mana (max 10). Ability Arcane Metamorphosis: 4,000 mana/s, 25s at >=96,001 mana, cooldown 90s, flame cascade leaving Walls of Fire (9s, 0.1s rehit).
